title: A DTR Moment For The Fed And Treasury
text:
A DTR Moment For The Fed And Treasury

Will Denyer

Gavekal Research | 31 Aug 2026

The annual Jackson Hole symposium has often been used by Federal Reserve chairs to signal major shifts in US monetary policy. Given recent events, the market was looking for Kevin Warsh to use his stage to “define the relationship” between the US central bank and the US Treasury. He delivered on this score.Consider the context. Warsh became chair just three months ago, after being handpicked by a president who has been openly critical of the Fed’s reluctance to cut interest rates and has threatened the institution’s independence by trying, unsuccessfully, to force out two of its top officials, Governors Jerome Powell and Lisa Cook.
